name: Donoghue v Stevenson [1932] AC 562 (Neighbour Principle)
summary: Landmark UK negligence case. Mrs Donoghue drank ginger beer containing decomposed snail. Lord Atkin established Neighbour Principle: you must take reasonable care to avoid acts or omissions which you can reasonably foresee would injure your neighbour. Foundation of modern tort of negligence in common law. Adopted across Commonwealth including Singapore.
